segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func fetchRecords( with ids: [CKRecord.ID], completionHandler: @escaping ( Result<[CKRecord.ID : Result<CKRecord, any Error>], any Error> ) -> Void ) -> Void { // Get a reference to the user's private database. let database = CKContainer.default().privateCloudDatabase // Create a configuration that denies cellular access. let config = CKOperation.Configuration() config.allowsCellularAccess = false // Configure the database and execute an expensive fetch. database.configuredWith(configuration: config) { db in db.fetch(withRecordIDs: ids, completionHandler: completionHandler) } } ```
